items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: . . . Yeah, behind Lady Day. It was in the South somewhere.

ctx.x: So then you left the Apollo and came back to L.A. then.
Oh yeah. Stopped here and there. Maybe Chicago and Kansas and everywhere. We went to – I had a band that went to – Lady Day. We were . . .
